visual_prior_specs.name: incremental_comparison_overlay_renderer
visual_prior_specs.content_description: A runtime overlay protocol for finding the odd item among repeated candidates by marking checked items, current comparison groups, and the current odd-item hypothesis directly on the task image.
visual_prior_specs.visual_rationale: The dynamic overlay externalizes checked candidates and the current hypothesis so the executor does not have to remember which near-identical items have already been compared.
visual_encodings: Neutral checked mark = candidate already inspected.
Dashed outline = current local comparison set.
Hypothesis outline or dot = current odd-item candidate.
Task image remains visible under all overlay marks.
text_exclusions: Feature comparison policy and stop criteria stay in Markdown text.
Final answer explanation stays in text, not in the overlay.
forbidden_elements: Opaque marks that hide candidate details
Long prose inside the rendered image
visual_prior_specs.renderer_description: Render checked candidate markers, the current comparison set, and the current odd-item hypothesis onto the original task image after each local comparison step.
renderer_outputs: overlay image with visible checked state and hypothesis

image_roles: Task input image containing repeated candidate items.
Dynamic overlay image with checked markers, current comparison set, and current odd-item hypothesis rendered onto the same task image.
binding_protocol.coordinate_system: Use image coordinates with origin at the top-left; use one coordinate representation consistently throughout a run.
text_to_visual_binding: Neutral marks bind to candidates already checked.
Dashed outline binds to the current comparison set.
Hypothesis outline or dot binds to the current odd-item candidate.
Candidate units are read from the current task image, not from the static preview.
task_binding_rules: Identify repeated candidate units in the task image.
Compare one local pair or cluster at a time in a stable scan order.
After each comparison, render checked state and the current hypothesis back onto the task image.
Stop only when every candidate has been checked or the difference is visually decisive.
anti_leakage_rules: Do not copy coordinates, object identities, or layouts from the static preview image.
Do not pre-render a fixed answer path or odd-item location.
Do not hide candidate details with large overlay marks.

runtime_protocol.update_rule: At round r, inspect the latest overlay image, compare the next unchecked candidate or local cluster, update checked state and hypothesis, then re-render the overlay for the next round.
runtime_protocol.stop_condition: Stop when all candidates are checked, the odd item is visually decisive, no valid candidate units remain, or max_rounds is reached.
runtime_protocol.renderer_spec: Renderer takes the original task image plus current comparison state and draws compact checked markers, a local comparison outline, and a current hypothesis marker. It must preserve candidate details and avoid encoding final answers before they are reached by the current run.

usage_constraints: The image asset is a static preview of overlay semantics, not the runtime prior itself.
At runtime, render marks onto the current task image after each comparison step.
Do not copy coordinates, object identities, or layouts from the preview.
Use text for comparison policy and use the overlay for visible working state.

assets.description: A static preview illustrating the visual semantics of the dynamic comparison overlay; runtime execution uses the renderer protocol.
